AC AMENDMENTS (gap-analysis #7 + #4 partial):

**--force bypass contract (gap-analysis #7)**:
- harvest-worktree.sh passes 'force' signal to the library via positional arg or env var (e.g., FORCE_BYPASS=1).
- The library defines which guards --force can bypass: PR-existence (YES), uncommitted-changes (YES — operator override), unmerged-commits (YES). Which it CANNOT bypass: 'protected branch' (NO — structural invariant, not a safety check).
- --force still prints all firing guards' messages AND PR URLs to stderr (DD#3); exit code becomes 0.
- Document the contract in the library header docstring.

**TOCTOU rationale for single-check (plan-review F3)**:
Add inline code comment at the single assert_worktree_removable call: 'TOCTOU single-check rationale: harvest-worktree.sh is a non-interactive batched fast path — the window between guard check and git worktree remove is sub-second. A second check would have negligible benefit. See plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe for the interactive-session-double-check rationale.'

Additional AC items:
- [ ] --force bypass propagated from harvest-worktree.sh to library
  Verify: grep -qE 'force|FORCE_BYPASS' plugins/dso/scripts/harvest-worktree.sh
- [ ] TOCTOU single-check rationale present
  Verify: grep -A 2 'TOCTOU single' plugins/dso/scripts/harvest-worktree.sh | grep -q 'batched fast path'
- [ ] Protected-branch guard is NOT bypassable by --force
  Verify: grep -qE 'protected.*force|protected.*bypass.*disallow' plugins/dso/scripts/lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh
